plain_english_policy: Use federal TANF funds to extend health and child care subsidies to the working poor.

effects.rationale: The policy aims to expand access to healthcare and childcare subsidies for the working poor.
The policy uses federal TANF funds to incentivize employers to provide child care subsidies, which is a form of employer incentive under the childcare delivery axis.

evidence_quote: "Use federal TANF (Temporary Assistance to Needy Families) funds to extend health and child care subsidies to the working poor." - Option e from Question on Welfare and Poverty Issues, Year: 2006.
